work.description: DCCLIX: complete Prompta ac pia voluntas five-clause constitution, Maximilian Joseph recipient, full eight-see nomination privilege and faith/obedience/canonical qualifications, legal clauses/sanctio and full datum LF59345–59350. Own date margin LF59184–59190 retained despite conflict between marginal day and closing idibus novembris; no normalized date supplied. Following DCCLX date margin LF59353–59359 excluded. XML leaves445–446 normal substantive L/R; wide LF59328 is running title only, no substantive column mixing. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
